title: banana teleport
description: Allows you to teleport tamed pets/yourself across dimesnion to another player.
body:
Both of these work across dimensions.

```
/teleportPet <target>
```
This gives you 15 seconds to select a pet to teleport to a the target.
Selecting is highlighted via a glow and u confirm it by right clicking it.


```
/teleportPlayer <target>
```
Teleports you to the targets location.
